title: Torsion-Anomalous Conjecture for Semiabelian Varieties
exact_target: Let $V$ be an irreducible subvariety of a semiabelian variety $G$. Prove that $V$ contains only finitely many maximal $V$-torsion-anomalous subvarieties.
